title: SEBI Closing Auction Session (CAS) Takes Effect August 3, 2026
summary: Introducing a Closing Auction Session for derivatives-eligible stocks prevents closing price manipulation.

blocks.content: Introducing a Closing Auction Session for derivatives-eligible stocks prevents closing price manipulation.

items: Introduces **Closing Auction Session (CAS)** for F&O-eligible (Category I) cash equity stocks.

**F&O Stock Timings:** Regular trading ends **3:15 PM**; Transition **3:15–3:20 PM**; CAS Order Entry I **3:20–3:25 PM**; CAS Order Entry II **3:25–3:30 PM** (market orders **cannot** be modified/cancelled); Order matching **3:30–3:35 PM**.
**Pre-Open Timings:** Order entry **9:00–9:07 AM**; Matching **9:07–9:15 AM**; Market opens **9:15 AM**.

blocks.title: Exam Trap & Statutory Distinction
blocks.content: CAS Order Entry I (3:20–3:25 PM, modification allowed) vs CAS Order Entry II (3:25–3:30 PM, modification prohibited).

blocks.quote:
Interview Focus Question: "Why did SEBI introduce a Closing Auction Session (CAS) for F&O stocks?"
💡 **Model Answer: It eliminates end-of-day price manipulation by discovering closing prices through a transparent volume-weighted auction.**
blocks.author: Banking & Regulatory Board Panel
